title: A History-Aware Visually Grounded Critic for Computer Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.11078v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Various test-time interventions for Computer Use Agents (CUAs), including critic models, have been developed to improve performance through pre-execution action evaluation in complex Graphical User Interface (GUI) environments. However, existing critics suffer from two key limitations: they (1) focus primarily on short-sighted decision loops (e.g., forgetting earlier actions) and (2) lack the visual grounding needed to detect flawed actions (e.g., clicking wrong UI elements). To address these, we introduce HiViG, a History-aware Visually Grounded test-time framework, built around a multimodal critic trained on real GUI trajectories to abstract past interactions into a compact record and to evaluate actions with visual grounding. translated_title: 面向计算机使用智能体的历史感知视觉定位评论模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.11078v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：为了在复杂的图形用户界面（GUI）环境中通过执行前动作评估来提升性能，研究者们已经开发了多种针对计算机使用智能体（CUA）的测试时干预方法，其中包括评论模型。然而，现有的评论模型存在两个关键局限：（1）主要聚焦于短视的决策循环（例如遗忘先前的动作）；（2）缺乏检测缺陷动作所需的视觉定位能力（例如点击了错误的UI元素）。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了HiViG，一个历史感知且具备视觉定位能力的测试时框架，其核心是一个在真实GUI轨迹上训练的多模态评论模型，该模型能够将过去的交互抽象为紧凑的记录，并以视觉定位的方式评估动作。在测试时，HiViG将评论模型集成到策略决策循环中，提供宏观动作历史（总结策略已完成的成就）以及视觉定位的评论（验证动作依据……）（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出HiViG框架，通过将历史交互抽象为紧凑记录并提供视觉定位的动作评估，解决了现有评论模型健忘和缺乏视觉定位的缺陷，从而提升计算机使用智能体在GUI环境中的表现。
en_tdlr: HiViG is a history-aware, visually grounded test-time critic framework that abstracts past interactions into compact records and visually verifies actions, overcoming memory and grounding limitations of existing critics to improve Computer Use Agents in GUI environments.
